gen-dafont-bloody-gf-montagu-slab: Bloody swells its lowercase into big, round bowls. Montagu Slab, a serif with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns, brings a quiet contrast that lets that loud heading settle into something readable.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Loud and round, Bloody plants big lowercase bowls up top, while Noto Serif Hentaigana below shows open jaws on every curve. Small letters nearly match the capitals, so text glides along.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with thins only slightly lighter than its thicks and a tall middle band. Bloody throws down big round bowls and a commanding tone, which Ovo's gentle taper from stem to joint quietly absorbs.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-domine: Domine reads with mellow modulation and a breathing space inside every curve, its tall lowercase tucked under compact ascenders. Bushcraft sprawls beside it in spaghetti-like lines, wide-spaced and playful against that dignity.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-esteban: Loose, wide-spaced and artistic, that is Bushcraft all over. Esteban brings oversized lowercase, thins only slightly slimmer than the stems, and an e that never squeezes shut, opening up what Bushcraft keeps closed.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-faustina: Faustina reads with bowls that thin gracefully and an open-jawed c like pliers, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Beside closed Bushcraft, paragraphs of it move with quiet authority.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-halant: Wiry, wide-spaced and unshaded, Bushcraft sets a loose, artistic scene first. And Halant, a serif with a towering x-height plus a faint thick-thin shift, reads with traditional authority paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-headland-one: Bushcraft keeps each glyph as simple as a single-tip drawing, spaced extra wide. Headland One keeps its letters well apart, never touching, with gentle tapered strokes that give paragraphs a dignified feel.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Extra-wide spacing defines Bushcraft, whose capitals barely stand out. Bushcraft excels at expressive, closed letterforms that never shift in weight, while Hedvig Letters Serif handles sturdy, open-ended text with medium contrast.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-marcellus-sc: Weight never shifts along any stroke of Bushcraft. Bushcraft is made for loose, expressive display lettering, while Marcellus SC, a serif with gentle modulation and pulled-back terminals, carries dignified, literary text.
